description: This file defines error handling utility functions and types for the 'operator' package in the project, including the AppError struct and methods to generate specific HTTP errors.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: Custom error type that includes a message, HTTP status code, and an underlying error. Implements the error interface.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error message string, including the underlying error if present.

methods.name: Unwrap
methods.description: Returns the nested error, enabling error unwrapping.

methods.name: JSONResponse
methods.description: Returns an API error message payload compatible with the frontend API.
